logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { fecha: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss a"}, level: p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: vars.env, apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: attributes.method, uriParam: if (!isEmpty(attributes.uriParams)) attributes.uriParams[0] else null, message: "Initiating orders " ++ attributes.method ++ " request to database", }]

db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, product_name, brand, price, quantity, discount, order_date) VALUES (:userId, :productName, :brand, :price, :quantity, :discount, :orderDate);
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { userId: (payload.userId default 0) as Number, productName: payload.productName default "", brand: payload.brand default "", price: (payload.price default 0) as Number, quantity: (payload.quantity default 0) as Number, discount: (payload.discount default 0) as Number, orderDate: now() }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "Order created successfully", status: "success", data: { orderId: vars.orderAdded.generatedKeys."GENERATED_KEY" as Number default null, userId: payload.userId, productName: payload.productName, brand: payload.brand, price: payload.price, quantity: payload.quantity, discount: payload.discount, orderDate: now()as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"} } }

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { fecha: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss a"}, level: p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: vars.env, apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: httpMethod: vars.saveMethod, details:{ message: "Order successfully post into database.", affected_rows: payload.affectedRows default 1, data_updated:payload.data } }]
